<p><strong>Python 3.13 和 3.14 版本</strong></p>
<p>带来了许多激动人心的改进，下面这个表格汇总了它们的核心新特性，可以帮助你快速了解这两个版本的主要变化。</p>
<div class="hyc-common-markdown__table-wrapper" data-has-scroll="false">
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>特性类别</th><th>Python 3.13 新特性</th><th>Python 3.14 新特性</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>🚀 性能与并发</strong>​</td>
<td>实验性免GIL模式、初步JIT编译器</td>
<td>解释器级GIL控制、尾调用解释器优化</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>✨ 开发体验</strong>​</td>
<td>全新交互式REPL、更智能的错误提示</td>
<td>模板字符串(t-string)、增强的错误建议</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>🛡️ 类型系统</strong>​</td>
<td><code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">ReadOnly</code>、<code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">TypeIs</code>、类型参数默认值</td>
<td><code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">ReadOnly</code>与 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">TypeIs</code>增强</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>🔧 工具与库</strong>​</td>
<td>清理过时模块、新的<code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">dbm.sqlite3</code>后端</td>
<td>原生Zstandard压缩、零开销调试接口</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3>🐍 Python 3.13 核心特性详解</h3>
<p>Python 3.13 是一个为未来打下坚实基础的版本，引入了一些实验性但极具潜力的特性。</p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>实验性的免GIL模式</strong>：这是最具革命性的特性。<strong>GIL</strong>​ 是限制Python利用多核CPU性能的历史包袱。3.13 允许通过特殊的构建（如 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">python3.13t</code>）或运行时标志来<strong>禁用GIL</strong>，从而实现真正的线程并行。这意味着专为多线程设计的程序在多核机器上能获得显著性能提升。需要注意的是，这仍是实验性功能，可能存在兼容性问题和单线程性能损耗。 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>初步的JIT编译器</strong>：3.13 引入了一个基于 <strong>Copy-and-patch</strong>​ 技术的实验性JIT编译器。它通过将“热”字节码编译成机器码来提升执行效率，尤其有利于计算密集型任务。目前需手动启用，为未来的性能飞跃铺平了道路。 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>全新的交互式解释器</strong>：基于PyPy项目的代码，新的REPL带来了现代编程体验，支持<strong>多行编辑</strong>、<strong>彩色语法高亮</strong>和<strong>彩色异常回溯</strong>，使得在命令行中与Python交互更加直观和高效。 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>类型系统增强</strong>：</span></span></span>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">ReadOnly</code>类型：可在 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">TypedDict</code>中将特定字段标记为只读，静态类型检查器会阻止对它们的修改，增强代码安全性。 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">TypeIs</code>类型：提供比 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">TypeGuard</code>更精确的类型收窄能力，帮助类型检查器在条件判断后更准确地推断变量类型。 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">类型参数默认值：<code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">TypeVar</code>等类型参数现在可以指定默认类型，提升了泛型编程的灵活性。 </span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>清理过时模块</strong>：根据PEP 594，移除了大量长期废弃的“死电池”模块，如 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">aifc</code>, <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">cgi</code>, <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">telnetlib</code>等，让标准库更加轻量和现代化。 </span></span></li>
</ul>
<h3>🐍 Python 3.14 核心特性详解</h3>
<p>Python 3.14 在 3.13 的基础上，进一步优化并引入了更实用的新功能。</p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>模板字符串</strong>：引入了 <strong>t-string</strong>，语法为 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">t"Hello, {name}!"</code>。与即时求值的f-string不同，t-string创建的是一个<strong>模板对象</strong>，可以延迟求值并在不同上下文中<strong>重复使用</strong>，特别适用于生成大量相似字符串的场景，如HTML模板或消息模板。 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>增强的模式匹配</strong>：在Python 3.10模式匹配的基础上，引入了<strong>守卫表达式</strong>。允许在 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">case</code>语句中直接使用 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">if</code>进行条件判断，让模式匹配更强大和简洁。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">match request:
    case {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GET</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: path} <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> path.startswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>):  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 守卫表达式</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">API request to {path}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>🐍 Python 3.13 新特性代码示例</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 启用免GIL模式运行程序</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 命令行方式：python3.13t --disable-gil your_script.py</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 或通过环境变量：PYTHON_GIL=0 python3.13 your_script.py</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sys
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> threading
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> compute_intensive_work(worker_id, iterations=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">10_000_000):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CPU密集型任务，适合多线程并行</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(iterations):
        result </span>+= i *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Worker {worker_id} 完成，结果: {result}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在免GIL模式下，多个CPU密集型线程可以真正并行执行</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_free_gil():
    threads </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(4):  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建4个工作线程</span>
        t = threading.Thread(target=compute_intensive_work, args=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(i, 5_000_000))
        threads.append(t)
        t.start()
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> t <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> threads:
        t.join()
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">所有线程完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注意：在标准GIL模式下，这些线程是并发而非并行</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在免GIL模式下，它们可以在多核CPU上真正并行执行</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><strong>2. ReadOnly 类型</strong></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> typing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TypedDict, ReadOnly
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> typing_extensions <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> NotRequired  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Python 3.11+</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserData(TypedDict):
    id: int
    name: str
    email: ReadOnly[str]  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ✅ 只读字段</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    is_active: bool
    metadata: NotRequired[dict]  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可选字段</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> process_user(data: UserData) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
    data[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">New Name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ✅ 允许修改</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> data["email"] = "new@email.com"  # ❌ 类型检查器会报错：ReadOnly字段</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 读取是允许的</span>
    email = data[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用户邮箱: {email}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用示例</span>
user: UserData =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Alice</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">alice@example.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这个值不能被修改</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">is_active</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: True
}

process_user(user)</span></pre>
</div>
<h2>🐍 Python 3.14 新特性代码示例&nbsp;</h2>
<h3><strong>1. 模板字符串（t-strings）</strong></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> t-string 创建模板对象，可以重复使用</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> string <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Template

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 传统 Template</span>
template1 = Template(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello, $name! You have $count messages.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
result1 </span>= template1.substitute(name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Alice</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, count=5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result1)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Hello, Alice! You have 5 messages.</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新特性：t-string（模板字符串）</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 语法：t"字符串 {变量}"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注意：这是语法层面的新特性，需要Python 3.14+</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 假设的 t-string 用法（实际语法可能有所不同）：</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> t_template = t"Hello, {name}! You have {count} messages."</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 实际可以这样使用：</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_email_template():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">创建可重用的邮件模板</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在 3.14 中可能会有直接的 t"" 语法</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 暂时用 Template 模拟</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Template(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
尊敬的 ${name}：

感谢您购买 ${product}。
订单号: ${order_id}
总金额: $${amount}

${store_name} 团队
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 多次使用同一个模板</span>
template =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_email_template()

email1 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> template.substitute(
    name</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    product</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Python编程指南</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    order_id</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ORD-2024-001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    amount</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">99.99</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    store_name</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">编程书店</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)

email2 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> template.substitute(
    name</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">李四</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
    product</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">数据结构与算法</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    order_id</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ORD-2024-002</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    amount</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">129.99</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    store_name</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">编程书店</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(email1)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>*50 + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(email2)</pre>

<h3><strong style="font-size: 1.17em">2. 模式匹配守卫表达式</strong></h3>
<div class="hyc-common-markdown__code">&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Python 3.10 引入了模式匹配</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Python 3.14 增强了守卫表达式</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> process_http_request(request: dict) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">处理HTTP请求，使用模式匹配和守卫表达式</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    
    match request:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 基本模式匹配</span>
        case {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GET</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/users</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">获取用户列表</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 带守卫表达式 (Python 3.14+)</span>
        case {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GET</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: path} <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> path.startswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">API请求: {path}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 复杂守卫条件</span>
        case {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">POST</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">body</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: body} 
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> isinstance(body, dict) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> body:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">处理数据: {body['data']}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 带时间戳的守卫</span>
        case {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GET</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">timestamp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: ts} 
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> isinstance(ts, int) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> ts &gt; 1700000000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> datetime <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> datetime
            dt </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">状态检查于: {dt}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认情况</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        case _:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未知请求</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 测试用例</span>
test_requests =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GET</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/users</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GET</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/products/123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">POST</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">body</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GET</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">timestamp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1704067200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},

    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> process_http_request(req)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{req} -&gt; {result}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>

<h3><strong>3. 解释器级GIL控制</strong></h3>
<div class="hyc-common-markdown__code">&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sys
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> threading
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_runtime_gil_control():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">运行时动态控制GIL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查当前GIL状态</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">当前GIL启用: {sys._is_gil_enabled()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 动态禁用GIL（Python 3.14+）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> hasattr(sys, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">set_gil_enabled</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">禁用GIL以执行CPU密集型任务...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        sys.set_gil_enabled(False)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> cpu_intensive_task(id, n=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">10_000_000):
            result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(n):
                result </span>+= i *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">任务 {id} 完成: {result}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建并行线程</span>
        threads =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(4<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
            t </span>= threading.Thread(target=cpu_intensive_task, args=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(i, 5_000_000))
            threads.append(t)
            t.start()
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> t <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> threads:
            t.join()
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重新启用GIL</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        sys.set_gil_enabled(True)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GIL已重新启用</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">当前Python版本不支持运行时GIL控制</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注意：动态GIL控制需要谨慎使用</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 某些C扩展可能依赖GIL</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><strong>4. 原生Zstandard压缩</strong></h3>
<div class="hyc-common-markdown__code">&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Python 3.14 内置 zstd 支持</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> compression.zstd as zstd
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> demo_zstd_compression():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">演示Zstandard压缩</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建测试数据</span>
    data =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">users</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
            {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: i, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">User_{i}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user{i}@example.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(10000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        ]
    }
    
    json_str </span>= json.dumps(data, indent=2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    original_size </span>= len(json_str.encode(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">原始数据大小: {original_size:,} 字节</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用Zstandard压缩</span>
    compressed = zstd.compress(json_str.encode(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    compressed_size </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> len(compressed)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">压缩后大小: {compressed_size:,} 字节</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">压缩率: {compressed_size/original_size:.1%}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解压缩</span>
    decompressed =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> zstd.decompress(compressed)
    decompressed_str </span>= decompressed.decode(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证数据完整性</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">assert</span> json_str ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> decompressed_str
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">数据完整性验证通过</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 流式压缩</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n流式压缩示例:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    with open(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_data.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        f.write(json_str)
    
    with open(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_data.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rb</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as src, \
         open(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_data.json.zst</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wb</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as dst:
        zstd.compress_stream(src, dst)
    
    compressed_file_size </span>= os.path.getsize(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_data.json.zst</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文件压缩后大小: {compressed_file_size:,} 字节</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 清理</span>
    os.remove(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_data.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    os.remove(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_data.json.zst</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 与gzip对比</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> gzip

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> compare_compression():
    data </span>= b<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 1000000
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> gzip</span>
    gzipped =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> gzip.compress(data)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> zstd</span>
    zstd_compressed =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> zstd.compress(data)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">原始: {len(data):,} 字节</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">gzip: {len(gzipped):,} 字节</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zstd: {len(zstd_compressed):,} 字节</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 性能对比</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time
    
    start </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> _ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        gzip.compress(data[:</span>10000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
    gzip_time </span>= time.time() -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> start
    
    start </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> _ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        zstd.compress(data[:</span>10000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
    zstd_time </span>= time.time() -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> start
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n压缩速度对比 (100次):</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">gzip: {gzip_time:.3f}秒</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zstd: {zstd_time:.3f}秒</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
